descriptionChirho: A person who falsely claims to speak on behalf of God or prophesies deceptively; Greek ψευδοπροφήτης, a compound of ψευδής (false) + προφήτης (prophet). Multilingual evidence is consistent across both clusters: eng 'false prophet(s),' spa 'falso(s) profeta(s),' hin झूठे भविष्यवक्ता (jhūṭhe bhaviṣyavaktā), arb أنبياء كذبة / النبي الكاذب, kor 거짓 선지자(들) (geojit seonjija), swa 'nabii wa uongo.' The two clusters split only on grammatical number — plural (S79180) vs singular (S79181) — with no semantic difference.
